estimation_metadata.demand: User-selected primary assumption: uplift demand by 20% only when the directional route's historical load factor is strictly greater than 0.80. At or below 0.80, use the historical carried-passenger mean without uplift. This is a modeling rule, not observed unmet demand. Raw observations are unchanged.
estimation_metadata.load_factor_formula: LF_r = sum_route(PASSENGERS) / sum_route(SEATS), using full historical route data before optimization, including historical 787 operations on retained routes.
estimation_metadata.demand_formula: q_f = [sum_route(PASSENGERS) / sum_route(DEPARTURES_PERFORMED)] * phi_r; phi_r=1.20 if LF_r>0.80, otherwise 1.00.
estimation_metadata.same_route_limitation: Flights on the same directional route retain the same estimated average demand; this assumption does not estimate time-of-day peaks.
